selection_rule: Select the evidence graphic and chart geometry by analytic purpose; chart types are not locked to a single layout.

layouts.purpose: Explain a tactical mechanism or space.
Compare up to five sourced team or player metrics.
Give a citation visual a clear role in the narrative.
Compare sourced numeric values using the geometry best suited to the categories and labels.

chart_type_rules.bar: Ranked values or long category labels; zero baseline required.
chart_type_rules.column: A small set of discrete category comparisons; zero baseline required.
chart_type_rules.pie/donut: Only mutually exclusive parts of a known whole; part_to_whole=true; two to four categories.

layouts.purpose: Show sourced values changing across ordered match moments or dates using a line chart.

data_integrity: Only render values supplied by reviewed evidence.
Missing source or values means omit the numeric visualization.
Show labels and source attribution; color alone never encodes meaning.
Radar charts require normalized comparable data and benchmark information.
previews: Renderer-exported examples in previews/ are illustrative and use no real match or citation.

statline_scorecard.composition: Dark split scoreboard; two teams face inward across centered metric labels.
statline_scorecard.visual_encoding: Large paired values plus mirrored within-row strokes; labels and source remain explicit.
statline_scorecard.best_for: A compact head-to-head of comparable team/player metrics.

chart_comparison.composition: Warm editorial plotting sheet with restrained registration marks, takeaway-first title, and geometry selected by data meaning.
chart_comparison.visual_encoding: Bar: horizontal rank/comparison; column: compact discrete comparison; pie/donut: labeled parts of a verified whole. Axes and direct values are visible where applicable.
chart_comparison.best_for: Comparisons whose category/part-whole semantics match the selected chart type.

chart_timeline.composition: Warm plotting sheet with a chronological line, subtle underlay, and event points.
chart_timeline.visual_encoding: Ordered labels, direct values, visible scale guides, and source note.
chart_timeline.best_for: Sourced values across ordered match moments or dates.

source_card.composition: Archival paper insert over an ink field, with an oversized quote mark and clipped corner.
source_card.visual_encoding: Publication and date precede the highlighted claim; URL sits in its own traceability strip.
source_card.best_for: Giving a claim visible provenance without pretending the source is match footage.

integrity_rules: pie and donut require part_to_whole=true and 2-4 non-negative values
invalid pie/donut input safely falls back to a zero-based bar
radar is excluded unless normalized comparable values and benchmark are explicit
